decisions.reason: Although a schlager compilation CD fits the firm's established knowledge in physical music retail, by 2022 it is an older CD-format release in a mature segment, so management is likely to redeploy resources unless demand remains clearly strong.

An illustrated music release series builds on the firm's existing catalogue and merchandising capabilities and offers scope to learn from collector demand, so it is somewhat more likely to be retained than discontinued.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP is closely related to the firm's music-specialist knowledge and to a collectible niche where experience and curation matter, making continued marketing more attractive.

A multi-disc music box set fits the firm's competence but is likely a costlier, limited-run collector product, so if post-launch learning shows only moderate turnover management would be inclined to phase it out.

Because this compilation music CD received weaker website prominence and is a less differentiated product in a declining physical format, management would likely judge its commercial improvement potential as limited and discontinue it.
